//: The stack normally runs in Docker (docker compose -p custom_erp up -d). These entries attach to it; nothing is started, so ports 3100/4100 never collide.

configurations.//: Default: the web app served by the `web` container.
configurations.name: app

configurations.//: Alias so a request for `web` attaches instead of launching a second copy.
configurations.name: web

configurations.//: The API served by the `api` container.
configurations.name: api

configurations.//: Hot reload on the host. Stop the container first: docker compose -p custom_erp stop web. Port is fixed: the API only allows CORS from WEB_ORIGIN (http://localhost:3100).
configurations.name: web-dev

configurations.//: Hot reload on the host. Stop the container first: docker compose -p custom_erp stop api. Port is fixed: the web bundle bakes NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://localhost:4100 at build time.
configurations.name: api-dev
